industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Green Resources Public Company Limited
summary: Green Resources Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business in Thailand. The company focuses on the development and sales of various properties, such as detached houses, semi-detached houses, and condominiums. It is also involved in initiating and developing projects related to energy; generates and distributes electricity from solar projects; and sale of products with installation of solar-cell systems. The company was formerly known as Asia Corporate Development Public Company Limited and changed its name to Green Resources Public Company Limited in February 2016. Green Resources Public Company Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand.
